releaseNotes:
1. Print-on-Bill Field Selection Checkboxes: Added 'Print on Bill' checkboxes for Branch, Physical Address, Phone, Email, GSTIN, PAN, FSSAI, Tagline, and Return Terms in Admin Hub. Unchecked items are excluded from print.
2. Unified Receipt Architecture: Both the Admin Hub Live Preview and the POS Checkout Receipt now use the EXACT SAME ThermalReceiptTicket component, ensuring 100% visual parity across preview and print.
